slides.title: WE PROTECT AND FOSTER THE SPIRIT OF OUR COMMUNITY.
slides.rawText: WE PROTECT AND FOSTER THE SPIRIT OF OUR COMMUNITY. STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT WORKSHOPS In selected private houses, Angel House brings together voices from leading innovation ecosystems who are ready to evolve. Participants discover how small groups can catalyse meaningful exchange across industries and engage in hands-on, collective activities that build real material and intellectual value for the community. These solutions are built by multi-generational teams and harness the constructive power of artificial intelligence.

slides.title: THE ANGEL FUND
slides.rawText: THE ANGEL FUND HELP ANGELS HEAL THE WORLD MISSION: ENABLE ANGELS TO GROW PROJECTS AND COMPANIES THAT CREATE REVENUE AND SOCIAL IMPACT. VISION: TO FINANCE ANGELS WHO ARE GROWING VALUABLE COMPANIES OR PROJECTS IN THE SPIRIT OF THE COMMUNITY. The Angel Fund selects growing projects and companies of Angels and supports with grants or funding. The fund is industry agnostic. Carefully selected companies are chosen by a distinguished investment committee. Angels are welcome to contribute Angel Checks of 50k €.
